Gideon, here's the draft for Mateo's procurement team. Times are from #inc-vtg-hartford and SUP-5380, all dated Aug 3, 2026.

DRAFT: Hartford gate kiosk incident (Vantorre, Aug 3, 2026)
- First report: 08:12 AM. SUP-5380 (Sev 1) logged that the reboot had failed and drivers were queuing. Gate kiosks were reported offline in the incident room at 10:42 AM.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for Carrowmere Cloud's reconnect attempts while they checked the Hartford gateway route.
- Open item: status-page access for Mateo's login is still being chased under INC-4821. Dispatch and the Pemberline Dock admin view were working throughout.

I haven't sent this to anyone outside the team. Say if you want a different incident or wording.

I posted the draft as a reply in #strategic-random, under your message. It's built from #inc-vtg-hartford and ticket SUP-5380, both dated Aug 3, 2026:

- **First report:** 08:12 AM. SUP-5380 (Sev 1) logged that the reboot had failed and drivers were queuing. Gate kiosks were reported offline in the incident room at 10:42 AM.

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosk incident (Vantorre, Aug 3, 2026)
- First report: 08:12 AM. SUP-5380 (Sev 1) logged that the reboot had failed and drivers were queuing. Gate kiosks were reported offline in #inc-vtg-hartford at 10:42 AM.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route from 10:51 AM. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for their reconnect attempts.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Open item: status-page access for Mateo's login is tracked in INC-4821. Mateo's admin account could open Pemberline Dock and see that day's arrivals (noted at 10:55 AM).

Sources: #inc-vtg-hartford and SUP-5380. Times are Aug 3, 2026.

Posted the final version in #strategic-random as its own message, starting with "FINAL:". It adds the Carrowmere Cloud gateway check (Odile Brandt, from 10:51 AM) and the INC-4821 status-page tracking. I also dropped the "working throughout" line from the earlier draft, since the channel doesn't support it.
